items.title: Sam Kininger interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 27, 2011
items.q: I was sort of in it already while I was at Berklee... there was a jazz big band at Berklee and it was called Kendrick Oliver New Life Jazz Orchestra... I was one of the original guys

ctx.x: I was sort of in it already while I was at Berklee. Around ’94 I started playing with a big band, well it was many other things, but there was a jazz big band at Berklee and it was called Kendrick Oliver New Life Jazz Orchestra.

Kendrink Oliver. They’re still around. Check them out. Kendrick Oliver New Life Jazz Orchestra. We started there, I was one of the original guys, and our first thing was like let’s play Count Basie charts, let’s play Duke Ellington charts, just to get the tradition. And then a faculty started writing charts for us, and then we started playing outside of the school, we started going to libraries and things around Boston. So that was how I started getting into Boston, in that big band. And what else. I played in…
